continuity.priorDecision: Uattzy network-wide tariff search was already anti-stagnation bounded; exact direct connector tariffs required.
continuity.identityNote: Historical UattzyGroup included ESH/GAS/UTZ; current canonical identity corrections remain authoritative and no alias merge is performed here.

findings.connectorPricing: Uattzy states that before charging with its app/account RFID, the tariff applied to each connector and any activation/occupancy charges are displayed.
findings.variability: Prices may vary by delivered power, session duration and bay occupancy; no safe national/power-only tariff grid can be inferred.
findings.roamingSeparation: Uattzy explicitly states that compatible third-party apps/RFID operators apply their own pricing policies.
findings.identityContext: Uattzy is the public charging brand of UAU, formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia; Uattzy describes itself as both CPO and eMSP.

blockingCondition: Exact Uattzy/E-Shore connector payload from app/backend or exact QR/POS payment surface mapped deterministically to current IT*ESH EVSE, including energy, activation and occupancy components.
antiStagnation: Do not repeat generic/network-wide tariff web search. Resume only from exact IT*ESH EVSE/QR/POS, Uattzy app/backend connector payload, or a new first-party direct tariff publication.
